summary.t: Gingerbread house - plywood and white acrylic

text.t:
Delicately laser-cut from pine plywood, these four gingerbread houses stand out with their charming details and the Merry Christmas inscription, celebrating the magic of this special season.
The delicate Christmas twine and wooden bead add a very special touch, while the white acrylic details add a touch of elegance, enhancing the natural beauty of the wood.
Small ornaments, designed to give your Christmas tree a timeless and cosy charm.
